title: H-DDCM: Hadamard Codebooks for Fast Generative Image and Video Compression
title_zh: H-DDCM：用于快速生成式图像与视频压缩的哈达玛码本

paragraphs.en: H-DDCM是一种无需训练的生成式压缩框架，利用哈达玛码本替代高斯码本，实现高效图像与视频压缩。 Training-free diffusion-based compression methods repurpose the generative priors of a diffusion or a flow model to compress data without retraining them as task-specific codecs. Recent codebook-based approaches such as Turbo-DDCM achieve strong perceptual quality at ultra-low bitrates, but their reliance on dense Gaussian codebooks remains costly in both memory and computation, and scales poorly with the large latent dimensions of modern image and video generators. Their combinatorial bitstream encoding further becomes computationally heavy at this scale. We introduce H-DDCM, a scalable generative compression framework that replaces Gaussian codebooks with implicit randomized Hadamard dictionaries. The fast Walsh-Hadamard transform allows for implicitly synthesizing full-dimensional dictionaries with $O(d \log d)$ compute for projection and reconstruction and $O(d)$ memory, without materializing the full-dimensional dictionary. We further introduce an efficient table-free lexicographic coding scheme that makes combinatorial encoding practical at larger dimensions. Beyond images, we adapt the framework to an autoregressive video flow model and develop a streaming compression scheme that periodically re-encodes recently reconstructed frames into a fresh KV-cache prefix, preserving temporal context across segments at no additional transmitted bits. This enables long-form, close to real-time generative video compression on a single GPU. Across image and video benchmarks, H-DDCM achieves competitive rate-distortion-perception performance while substantially reducing the memory and computational overhead of codebook-based training-free generative compression.
paragraphs.zh: H-DDCM 是一种无需训练的生成式压缩框架，它利用哈达玛码本替代高斯码本，实现高效的图像与视频压缩。无需训练的扩散模型压缩方法会重新利用扩散模型或流模型的生成先验知识，从而无需将其重新训练为特定任务的编解码器即可压缩数据。 近期基于码本的方法（如 Turbo-DDCM）在极低比特率下仍能保持出色的感知质量，但它们对密集高斯码本的依赖在内存和计算成本上依然高昂，并且随着现代图像和视频生成模型较大的潜在维度而表现不佳。 在这种规模下，它们的组合位流编码过程也会变得计算量巨大。 我们提出了 H-DDCM，一个可扩展的生成式压缩框架，该框架用隐式的随机化哈达玛字典替代了高斯码本。 快速的沃尔什-哈达玛变换使得无需显式构建全维度字典，即可通过 $O(d \log d)$ 的计算完成投影与重建，且仅需 $O(d)$ 的内存。 我们还提出了一种高效的无表法字典序编码方案，使组合编码在更大维度下也能实用化。 除了图像领域，我们还将该框架适配到自回归视频流模型中，并开发了一种流式压缩方案：该方案会周期性地重新编码最近重建的帧，将其整合为新的 KV-cache 前缀，从而在不增加传输比特数的情况下保留各片段之间的时序上下文。 这使得在单 GPU 上实现长视频的近实时生成式压缩成为可能。 在图像和视频基准测试中，H-DDCM 实现了具有竞争力的速率-失真-感知性能，同时显著降低了基于码本的无需训练生成式压缩方法在内存和计算方面的开销。
